done_when: Full-access worker turns (build, fix, lite) run with no approval gate: every approval request Codex sends is accepted and Codex's automatic approval review isn't used, so any command the worker runs goes ahead; read-only turns (cold read, ask, review) keep declining everything; tests run a full-access turn whose command triggers an approval request and see it accepted, and a read-only turn see it declined
why: Codex worker turns decline every approval request, so commands Codex's own safety check flags, like a test run against a local test database, are refused even though workers are meant to have full access, costing many blind rounds
